record.title: Evaluate the input-impedance remedy before resuming RF acquisition
record.intent: Distinguish an ordinary prerequisite correction from alteration of the RF hypothesis.
requirements: Inspect the actual prerequisite-stop conclusion, independent review, normalization/restoration change and prepared evidence bindings. State whether the already-authorized ordinary 50-ohm selection supports a fresh A1 attempt without weakening a measurement guard.

Record GO or HOLD with exact evidence. A GO requires the prerequisite stop to have contained no source/settings writes or waveform record, unchanged policy/source/numerical semantics and a complete known-safe restore path. Preserve the stop rather than relabel it as a completed arm.

Commit and push the conclusion and tasking before any fresh physical execution. The subsequent acquisition remains governed by TASK.rf.acquire and the frozen comparison contract; no added wiring, option, calibration or firmware intervention is authorized.
acceptance: A reasoned GO or HOLD resolves the sole ordinary-impedance remedy.
